newsitem.title: DUBAI: Germany's West LB to open Dubai rep office.
newsitem.headline: Germany's West LB to open Dubai rep office.

text.p: Germany's Westdeutsche Landesbank (West LB) on Tuesday announced plans to open its first Middle East representative office in Dubai, the United Arab Emirates, on October 19.

West LB will offer corporate and private customers all banking services, including investment banking products, asset management, corporate finance, trade and project finance, the bank said in a press release issued in Dubai.

"This move...will allow us to diversify our operations in new markets," West LB's senior representative Eugene van Dongen said in the press release. "The domestic market is vibrant and had well-established links throughout the Gulf states, Iran and neighbouring markets."
There are 27 foreign banks, 15 representative offices and 19 local banks operating in the IAE.
